page_title: AceTagGen | Stop Guessing Your SUNO Prompts

sources.entry: AceTagGen - Free prompt builder for Suno AI. Structured dropdowns for mood, genre, instruments, and SFX that respect Suno's 200-char Style limit. Includes example library and quality score.

summary.name: AceTagGen
summary.one_liner: A free web-based prompt builder for Suno AI that uses structured dropdowns, tag libraries, and a 100-point prompt scorer to help write Style and Lyrics prompts.
use_cases: Writing structured Style prompts for Suno AI songs
Checking a Suno prompt for conflicting tags before generating
Adding bracket tags to lyrics section by section
Choosing genre, mood, and instrument tags without music theory
Integrating a prompt validator into other tools
summary.what_it_does: The site offers a 12-step tag builder that walks users through genre, mood, instruments, vocals, tempo, and production, with a live preview, character counter, and collision warnings. A 100-point quality score checks length, tag collisions, specificity, and density, and a 15-point validation grid flags invalid tags, per-category limits, and bracket syntax problems. A Song Editor adds bracket tags line by line to lyrics and includes an AI lyrics writer in 12 languages. Builds can be copied, saved to a local library, or exported as text, JSON, or PNG. The page also describes a paid AceTagGen AI that generates prompts from plain-language descriptions, and a blog of Suno research articles.
notable: Free 100-point prompt scorer with a public REST API and MIT-licensed core scoring algorithm
3,200+ tags, 1,700+ sub-genres, and 430+ instruments with audio previews
Line-level Song Editor with 300+ bracket tags and auto song-structure detection
caveats: The paid AceTagGen AI assistant is separate from the free tag builder; pricing details are not given on the page
Claims about Suno behavior (tag weights, percentages, model clusters) are the site's own research and are not independently verified here
Tag rules are tied to specific Suno model versions (e.g., V4.5 and V5) and may change with new releases
